Excellent opportunity to expand your mining career as either a Warehouse Operator or Core Technician    Your new company     Our client is among the world's top producers of major commodities including iron ore, metallurgical coal, copper, and uranium. They extract and process minerals, oil and gas from its production operations located primarily in Australia and the Americas.     Your new role     
 Warehouse Operator 
 
 Operate forklifts, reach trucks and other material handling equipment safely and efficiently 
 Receive, unpack, sort and store incoming deliveries 
 Use RF scanners to manage inventory and receive goods 
 Assist with warehouse maintenance and customer enquiries 
 Work independently and as part of a team 
 
   
 Core Technician 
 
 Prepare core samples using diamond saws and other equipment 
 Measure and record core sample data for laboratory analysis 
 Photograph and upload sample records to the database 
 Maintain safe work practices and assist with continuous improvement 
 Move and transfer core samples, including forklift operation 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 To succeed with either position, you will have: 
   
 
 Current Australian Drivers Licence 
 Current Forklift Licence 
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy 
 Safety-focused approach with a willingness to follow procedures 
 Ability to work effectively in a team environment 
 Strong customer service and communication skills 
 
   What you'll get in return     
 Join a global mining organisation doing FIFO from Adelaide, working a lifestyle-friendly 7/7 roster with 12-hour shifts and an excellent starting hourly rate. You'll be part of a safety-focused team environment while gaining valuable experience within a world-class mining operation.

About CALHN
At Central Adelaide (CALHN), we're shaping the future of health through excellence in clinical care, research, and innovation. As South Australia's largest health network, we deliver exceptional, safe and connected healthcare - for our patients, our community, and our people.

With more than 17,000 dedicated employees, every day at CALHN presents an opportunity to make a real impact-not because it's expected, but because our values guide us to be our best. Find out more about CALHN sites and services, our stories and the opportunities to be part of CALHN.

About the Role

Join our team and help patients access timely, high quality care. You'll manage procedure waitlists, coordinate bookings, build strong relationships with clinical teams, maintain accurate data and create efficient workflows that support safe, equitable and patient centred services.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage procedure waitlists and patient bookings
- Coordinate surgery and scope schedules
- Maintain accurate data and patient records
- Monitor waitlist performance and timeframes
- Liaise with patients, carers and clinical teams
- Build strong partnerships across services
- Prepare reports and routine correspondence
- Resolve enquiries with care and professionalism
- Support efficient workflows and service delivery
- Contribute to safe, equitable patient care

About You

You're a proactive administrator who thrives in a fast paced healthcare environment. You balance competing priorities, communicate with confidence and take pride in delivering accurate, patient focused support that helps people access care sooner.

- Experience in healthcare admin or waitlist management
- Skilled in Microsoft Office and patient record systems
- Prioritise deadlines with accuracy and sound judgement
- Build strong relationships across multidisciplinary teams
- Handle confidential information with care and professionalism

To do that, we need you.

This role will support the Service Manager in a range of day to day administrative and support tasks. Being the first point of contact for residents, families and staff, you will be responsible for providing courteous reception and administrative support, including rostering of the staff at the facility. Assist with the roster management and back filling shifts and leave management

Responsible and accountable for the day-to-day activities of the office ensuring administrative, clerical and reception services are provided to the residents, visitors and staff.

Provide timely and effective support to managers.

Efficient and effective maintenance of document and data storage.

What you'll bring

You're reliable, resilient and have a whole lot of heart. Most importantly, you are genuinely interested in supporting others and making a difference in your community.

To thrive in this role, you will have:

Previous experience in managing roster and administrative role, preferably in a healthcare or aged care setting.

Front of house service being able to communicate with all customers to Mercy Place Albury.

Proficiency in computer applications such as Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

High level of interpersonal, organisational & communication skills (written and verbal).

High attention to detail and previous knowledge of roster planning.

Excellent time management skills and an ability to manage conflicting priorities.

Experience in Aged Care or Health environment (desirable but not essential).

A sense of empathy & compassion for elderly residents & their families.

A commitment to maintaining confidentiality around client data records.

You will also be required to provide evidence of, or in the process of obtaining:

National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) Clearance.

Current COVID-19 certificate, proof of current influenza vaccination and other vaccination status consistent with public health orders.

Retail Manager

Business: Shareefs Concord Pty Ltd (Trading as Shareef's – The Shawarma Social Club)
Location: Concord NSW 2137
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing
Salary: AUD $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Business
Shareefs Concord Pty Ltd, trading as Shareef's – The Shawarma Social Club, is a contemporary Lebanese quick-service restaurant located in Concord, New South Wales. Inspired by the vibrant café culture of 1960s and 1970s Beirut, the business specialises in authentic Lebanese shawarma and Mediterranean-inspired cuisine, delivering exceptional dine-in, takeaway, catering, and delivery services to customers throughout Sydney. The business combines traditional flavours with modern hospitality practices to provide a distinctive and memorable dining experience. 
Operating within Australia's highly competitive hospitality and food service industry, Shareef's is committed to maintaining exceptional food quality, outstanding customer service, and operational excellence across all aspects of its business. The restaurant operates in a fast-paced environment requiring effective workforce management, inventory control, quality assurance, and strict compliance with food safety and workplace obligations. The business is built upon strong values of authenticity, innovation, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement while maintaining compliance with all relevant Australian hospitality and workplace regulations. 
With increasing customer demand, expanding operational requirements, and continued business growth, Shareefs Concord Pty Ltd requires an experienced Retail Manager to provide dedicated operational leadership across the restaurant's daily operations. The role is essential to maintaining service quality, managing workforce performance, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting the continued growth and sustainability of the business.

Position Overview
The Retail Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of the restaurant's daily operations, ensuring efficient service delivery, strong financial performance, exceptional customer experiences, and effective workforce management. The position requires hands-on leadership within a high-volume hospitality environment and accountability for operational compliance, people management, inventory control, food quality standards, and business performance.
Working closely with kitchen staff, customer service employees, suppliers, and senior management, the Retail Manager plays a critical role in maintaining operational excellence while ensuring that Shareef's continues to deliver authentic Lebanese cuisine and outstanding hospitality experiences to its customers.
This is a senior operational position ideally suited to an experienced hospitality professional capable of leading teams, maintaining operational standards, and driving continuous business improvement within a fast-paced restaurant environment.

Key Responsibilities
Restaurant Operations and Performance
•	Plan, coordinate, and manage the day-to-day operations of the restaurant to achieve sales, service, and productivity objectives.
•	Ensure consistent compliance with operational procedures, food safety standards, and workplace health and safety requirements.
•	Monitor business performance indicators, including labour costs, food costs, wastage, profitability, and operational efficiency.
•	Maintain consistently high standards of food quality, customer service, and restaurant presentation.
Leadership and Workforce Management
•	Recruit, train, roster, supervise, and motivate restaurant employees across customer service and kitchen operations.
•	Provide ongoing coaching, performance feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
•	Foster a positive workplace culture focused on teamwork, accountability, customer service excellence, and continuous improvement.
•	Manage staffing requirements to ensure adequate workforce coverage during peak trading periods.
Customer Service and Hospitality Management
•	Oversee customer service delivery across dine-in, takeaway, catering, and delivery service channels.
•	Resolve customer enquiries, feedback, and complaints promptly and professionally.
•	Maintain exceptional hospitality standards that enhance customer satisfaction and encourage repeat patronage.
•	Monitor customer experiences and implement service improvements where appropriate.
Inventory Management and Cost Control
•	Manage inventory levels, supplier relationships, stock ordering, deliveries, and stock rotation processes.
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and implement cost control measures to minimise wastage and maximise profitability.
•	Monitor operational expenditure and identify opportunities to improve business performance.
•	Ensure restaurant equipment and operational assets are appropriately maintained and fully operational.
Compliance and Administration
•	Ensure compliance with Fair Work obligations, food safety legislation, workplace health and safety requirements, and internal operational policies.
•	Prepare operational reports, sales summaries, stock reports, and performance data as required by management.
•	Maintain accurate business records and implement organisational policies and procedures across all operational areas.
•	Assist in implementing continuous improvement initiatives that support operational excellence and business sustainability.

Skills & Experience
Essential Requirements
•	Proven experience in retail or hospitality management within a fast-paced environment
•	Strong leadership capability with demonstrated experience managing teams and rosters
•	Sound understanding of cost control, inventory management, and retail performance metrics
•	High level of organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
•	Ability to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and public holidays

Preferred Qualifications
•	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma (ANZSCO Skill Level 2)
•	At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications listed above. In some instances relevant experience and/or on-the-job training may be required in addition to the formal qualification.
•	Current food safety certification or willingness to obtain
•	Prior experience within QSR or franchised food retail operations

Work Environment
The Retail Manager role is hands-on and operational, requiring active involvement on the shop floor alongside the team. The position demands strong time management, an open schedule resilience under pressure, and the ability to lead by example in a high-volume service environment.
Note - Preference will be given to Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents.

Cabrini Malvern

We're building for the better!

By 2036, more than 150,000 patients will look to us for healthcare every year.

Perioperative Services

As part of our growth, we are adding four additional cutting-edge operating theatres and an additional Cath lab with construction underway and due for completion mid 2026.

Equipped with advanced technology, our department supports over 1800 operations each month.

Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless booking of patients for procedures

Focus on delivering high standards of customer service for our patients, family members, nursing staff and medical officers in a fast-paced environment.

Perform Reception administrative duties, and data entry into our Patient Administrative System (PAS)

Liaise with doctor's rooms and nursing staff to ensure correct patient and procedure details are obtained

Answer telephones and ensures accurate recording and delivery of messages

Respond quickly to emergency situations, ensuring correct personnel are contacted.

You will have

Proven clerical experience, hospital setting desired. (preferred)

Proficient in Microsoft Office, Excel and Teams

Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and can problem solve.

A positive attitude and be adaptable to change within an evolving service

Excellent communication and time management skills and work respectfully within a team environment.

Perioperative Services offers flexible working arrangements

Working with the latest modern technology, established surgeons and Anaesthetists
